metadata.title: Gritty Urban Portrait with High-Contrast Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, warm-toned urban portrait featuring extreme close-up photography with a heavy film grain texture and a structured, boxed typographic lockup in the lower corner.

recipe.visualDefinition: An extreme close-up of a face angled diagonally, illuminated by a single warm light source that emphasizes skin texture and metallic dental accessories, set against a dark, grainy background with a white-bordered text block in the bottom right.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm amber highlights contrasting with deep black shadows
Heavy film grain unifying the photographic and graphic elements
Diagonal facial orientation creating dynamic tension
Rigid geometric text box anchoring the fluid organic forms of the face
coreInvariants: Extreme close-up cropping that cuts off the top and sides of the head
High-contrast lighting that leaves half the face in near-total shadow
Visible film grain and dust textures across the entire frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face is the primary subject, scaled to fill 80% of the frame, positioned at a 45-degree tilt.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright metallic reflection of the teeth/grillz serves as the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal line of the nose down to the mouth, then moves to the structured text block in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space occupies the upper right and lower left corners, framing the face.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and golden yellow (highlights/skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in shadows with high value contrast in the highlights and white text.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme vertical elongation for primary display text
Uniform stroke weight for secondary metadata
Tight letter spacing to fit within rigid rectangular borders
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between ultra-condensed display type and wide, heavy geometric sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed, high-impact display style.
Matches the sturdy, geometric feel of the metadata text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, low-key portrait of a face at a diagonal angle, lit with warm amber light. Apply a heavy film grain and dust texture. Ensure the bottom right corner has dark space for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a white-bordered rectangular box in the bottom right. Inside, place ultra-condensed sans-serif text at the top, followed by horizontal rules and smaller, heavy geometric sans-serif text below.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting warm and high-contrast?
Is the film grain visible across the entire image?
Is the text contained within a structured white-bordered box?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the white border box
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject

avoid: Digital noise instead of film grain

postGenerationChecks: Verify text legibility against the dark background
Ensure the gold/metallic elements have specular highlights
Confirm the grain doesn't obscure the typographic lines
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Extreme Close-up Portrait] + [Low-key Amber Lighting] + [Heavy Film Grain] + [Boxed Condensed Typography].
